routing_warnings.description: The reported chapter-2 starting point and chapter-1 expectation concern the independently defined image-coverage rule rather than the general new-file image-addition deliverable.
The spelling-check instruction applies to generated images rather than the Canada citizenship proofreading deliverable.
The client explicitly assigns image checking to the image-generation phase and excludes it from proofreading.
The observed chapter-2 start and the instruction to begin at chapter 1 concern the independent cross-book image-coverage rule.
The book-specific exception rule changes the scope semantics of the chapter-1 coverage Requirement.
The instruction to check spelling in every added image establishes the independent generated-image spelling standard.
The message assigns image spelling checks to the image-generation phase rather than changing delivery of the Ontario images.
The per-image checking and regeneration instructions concern spelling accuracy, which is independently testable from image delivery.
In the context of message 94, this is a claim that the Ontario images were checked and belongs to the spelling-accuracy Requirement.
